_comment: Per-machine performance tuning. Copy to host.json (same dir) and edit. Resolution precedence per setting: VOB_* env var > a per-key field here > the capacity tier > the RAM-derived default. Delete host.json (or leave it absent) to fall back entirely to RAM-derived defaults. Run `vob_doctor` to see the resolved effective values and where each came from.
_capacity: Single shortcut: "low" | "medium" | "high" expands to a bundle (render_workers, encode_concurrency, render_quality, video_budget, video_hard_cap). Per-key fields below still override individual values. Omit to keep RAM-derived defaults.
_per_key: Any of these override the capacity tier and the RAM default. Comment out to fall back.
_browser_gpu: GPU backend, NOT part of the capacity tier (GPU availability is independent of RAM). "software"|"off" = SwiftShader anywhere; "hardware"|"on" = host GPU; "auto" = let hyperframes probe. Leave unset for the platform default (software on macOS).
